checks.name: Submission inventory, exact regenerated files and trajectory privacy
Independent exact-rational financial and causal audit
Sized batch-payment books at both published endpoints

finance.scope: Independent local financial integrity check; no official jury score or difficulty claim.

mutations.description: Round FX conversions toward zero instead of half-even.
mutations.expected_detection: Independent source-to-ledger conversion disagrees at a fractional minor unit.
An amount one minor unit beyond tolerance does not earn a TP.

mutations.description: Inflate the true-positive count by one.
mutations.expected_detection: The evaluator cannot credit more matches than a complete correct answer contains.

mutations.description: Count every matching submission, including repeated findings.
mutations.expected_detection: Repeating an otherwise correct finding adds a false positive.

mutations.description: Include evaluator truth in the reset observation.
mutations.expected_detection: Initial public observation contains a forbidden evaluator field.

mutations.description: Include the exclusive period end in the reporting window.
mutations.expected_detection: An entry at the exclusive closing boundary is outside the period.

mutations.description: Ignore the supplied seed when initializing generation.
mutations.expected_detection: Identical inputs must yield byte-equivalent financial episodes.
The hundredth inspection truncates the episode.

mutations.description: Publish an invoice identifier where a document evidence ID is required.
mutations.expected_detection: Every required evidence ID resolves to a sufficient public source.

mutations.description: Drop unmatched truth entries from the false-negative count.
mutations.expected_detection: An omitted true issue contributes exactly one FN.

mutations.description: Give an empty correct submission zero F1 on a clean company.
mutations.expected_detection: A clean company with no submitted findings earns F1=1.

mutations.description: Skip one source record between every two consecutive pages.
mutations.expected_detection: Concatenated pages equal the full ordered source table.

mutations.description: Accept a single overlapping item from a mandatory evidence set.
mutations.expected_detection: Removing a necessary item from a finding eliminates its TP.

mutations.description: Allow submit after an episode already terminated.
mutations.expected_detection: A second submit cannot produce new terminal reward.

mutations.description: Understate the invoice liability by one minor unit.
mutations.expected_detection: Independent bookkeeping rejects unequal debits and credits in the pristine journal.

mutations.description: Inject discrepancies even when clean generation was requested.
mutations.expected_detection: A clean configuration produces zero discrepancies.

mutations.scope: Local business/accounting/contract mutation testing; not official grading.

limitations: CPU/RAM isolation requires Docker; tracemalloc is not process RSS.
No model weights trained; no learning improvement claimed.
Oracle is evaluator-only; its inspection strategy is not optimized.
official_approximation.scope: Local approximation of published checks; hidden organizer tests unavailable.
